Indian IT and Engineering Firms Report Mixed Q1 Financial Results

Several Indian companies have released their first-quarter financial results for the fiscal year. Wipro reported a nearly flat profit but an increase in revenue, while also declaring an interim dividend. Bharat Heavy Electricals (BHEL) swung to a net profit, and Nelco also saw its revenue and profit rise. These results provide a snapshot of performance in key industrial and IT sectors.
